name: start_camera_target_position_transition

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_StartCameraTargetPositionTransition reads four values from the Script value stack, stores the duration and target X/Y/Z coordinates in camera transition state, and decrements Script stackTop by four

notes: ScriptCommand_StartCameraTargetPositionTransition snapshots the current camera target at D_003C0E30 through D_003C0E38, stores the requested target at D_003C0DD0 through D_003C0DD8, resets elapsed time, and enables transition flag 0x1. func_001C9EC0 advances elapsed time and interpolates each coordinate through the camera easing function before rebuilding the camera. All 63 JP calls occur after command 513 enable_event_camera in the same entry; every call is followed by command 50 and then command 51 to start synchronized rotation and distance transitions.
